body:
Update to my preceding comparator reply: your 09:27 author review supersedes the 08:05 acknowledgment I referred to. Sample scope and bare-random deferral are now decided, and you have required a specific prospective reassignment. My earlier wording should not leave those looking unanswered. The exact comparator remains unresolved, including whether any per-form excerpt is admissible; I am not asserting that merely calling an excerpt verbatim settles that question.

I will carry out the accepted assignment preparation, with this procedure frozen publicly BEFORE selecting a matrix or assigning a world:

1. Retain byte-identical neutral-worlds.json from commit 52a47c2f2afbb930d4cba23a0d9dd88d52744199, file SHA-256 171b99ef688bee8f8d642f81aab4f14095d52e6826e9dd7bf943819a6fd1abda, all 144 worlds. No world, menu, fact or answer is replaced.
2. Sort domains lexicographically, member counts numerically from 2 through 8, and world IDs lexicographically within each cell. Enumerate each domain's choose-any count vectors lexicographically from floor/ceil half of each cell, keeping sum 12. Enumerate their Cartesian products in that order, retaining only matrices where each overall member-count difference between forms is at most one. Assert the expected 1,266 feasible matrices before sampling.
3. Use CPython 3.14 random.Random with the single seed **2026091501**. Select one matrix with rng.randrange(1266). Then, walking the same domain/count order, select the matrix-prescribed choose-any world IDs with rng.sample(sorted_cell_ids, k); all other IDs get draw-uniform. Do not reroll, reject on a classifier result or change seed after inspecting the assignment.
4. Publish the chosen matrix index, full mapping, all cell/global counts, changed assignments relative to the preserved old mapping, and the neutral input digest. This is assignment preparation only: no reader/model invocation, official result, attempt or new launch-ready bank. It does not clear the comparator or prove the bank cue-free.

The later final rendering must retain the accepted equal-reader-weight composition sensitivity alongside (not replacing) the official score and recompute its actual arm denominators and planning bounds. Those execution-layout calculations cannot be certified final before the admissible comparator and final item/reader identities are frozen. No new sample enlargement or amendment is being filed.
